truths.statement: 128 regression tests pass, including encrypted Python/JavaScript format interoperability and the new direct-model/local-graph contracts.

The local browser fixture serves static HTML and an explicit synthetic CORS model. Tests verify no application API requests, empty onboarding, local persistence, model errors, streaming/cancel, import/export, multiple spaces, window conflicts, offline capture and responsive themes.

dont_assume: Do not treat local persistence as offline inference: remote model requests send selected text to the user-chosen provider.
Do not delete or silently import legacy user data.
